nodes.name: imap_trigger
nodes.notes: IMAP user/password are per-developer and configured only in n8n credentials; they are intentionally not exported here.
nodes.description: Reviews the inbox over IMAP. Credentials (user/password) are configured per developer in n8n and never appear in this export or in code.

nodes.name: parse_recipe_email
nodes.notes: Extracts reply_to, codigo_far, hasAttachment and safeFilename; keeps the first attachment under the binary property 'attachment'. Emits an empty array when there is no message; never throws.

nodes.name: read_ordenes
nodes.notes: Reads sheet 'ordenes' range A:M with the header row.

nodes.name: build_action
nodes.notes: Returns one item with the classified action and the final Spanish reply for every non-UPLOAD action. Also carries subject (already 'Re: <original>'), driveName and medicamento_id downstream.

nodes.name: if_upload
nodes.notes: true -> upload_to_drive; false -> send_email (the item already carries the final message).

nodes.name: upload_to_drive
nodes.notes: Parameter choice: typeVersion 2.1 with operation=upload, folderId (resource locator, id mode) = $env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_RECETAS_FOLDER_ID, binaryPropertyName=attachment, destination name = item.driveName (from buildDriveName(codigo, Date.now(), safeFilename)). Mirrors the photo path (US-09-recetas-telegram) so both halves of US-09 share the same Drive parameter shape. OPEN RISK: parameter validation happens on first import; adjust key names if the imported node flags them. url_receta is surfaced from the upload output (webViewLink/webUrl, falling back to id-based link in update_orden).
nodes.description: Uploads the IMAP attachment with destination name buildDriveName(codigo, timestampMs, safeFilename) and surfaces url_receta. Parameter validation happens on first import: open risk.

nodes.name: update_orden
nodes.notes: Keyed on codigo_far; writes url_receta, fecha_receta and estado=RECETA_RECIBIDA.

nodes.name: append_bitacora
nodes.notes: Appends bitacora row: accion=RECETA_RECIBIDA, delta_reservado=0, detalle='adjunto recibido por correo'.

nodes.name: finalize_success
nodes.notes: Emits { source, reply_to, subject, message } with the success copy and subject 'Re: <original subject>' (already prefixed in build_action).

nodes.name: send_email
nodes.notes: Sends the reply by email to reply_to with subject 'Re: <original subject>'. SMTP credentials are per-developer and configured only in n8n; no credentials block is exported.
